motion_rule: the tray drives her down the aisle every beat; crates and ice sweep across the lens a fin away; camera tracks alongside at her height; new shot size each beat, never wider than her head a third of frame; ONE sideways move per window, never up or down
character: a plump mackerel with a mirror-striped flank, lying along the tray, jaw working, eye always clear
second_characters: ONE fat seller woman in a white forage cap and stained apron, gold teeth, running level with the tray from 6.45 and crossing the lens; ONE buyer, arms only, at 8.10
props: A SWARM of grey salmon heads dumped in a battered soup crate with a hand-written card wired to it; ONE price card; ONE clear plastic bag; ONE fish bone behind her ear
prop_continuity: the heads stay in the crate from 1.90; the price card rides with her from 6.45; the bone leaves the ear at 9.20
environment: a fish hall, daylight from the roof, tiled counters and crates a fin away both sides, no far wall; a scale belt along the aisle

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; the cards are never read out
audio.delivery: a smug oily female voice, biting each word, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: prosh-LI, vre-me-NA, lo-SO-sya, te-PER, O-che-red, blis-TAT, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.90, 2.15-4.25 and 4.50-6.45 each one breath; after 6.45 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens wide and shapes every syllable
audio.sfx: ice crunching, trays scraping, crates banging, a belt whirring, running boots, a wet cackle

timeline.a: the tray shoves off past a crate raking the lens
she rides on, ice sheeting past the lens
her tail whips and hurls the grey salmon heads off the tray into the crate
the heads crash in and the crate swings past the lens, its wired card first
she shoulders the last ice off the tray past the lens
she throws her body over, the tray skidding under her
she drives her flank at the lens, crates banging past both sides
the tray swerves, her flank ripping across the lens
the tray hits a rut, ice jumping sideways
she leans in at the lens, jaw wide, the aisle tearing past
the tray slams a rut, ice sheeting across the lens
she throws her flank at the lens, crates ripping past
the seller woman tears in level and slaps the price card onto her ice, both sweeping past the lens
still running she hurls her off the tray onto the scale belt, the needle whipping round as the belt drives her past the lens
the belt feeds her into the bag swung open on the run, the bag whipping across the lens, her thrashing inside
the buyer arms snatch the bag and swing it past the lens, her flank slamming the plastic
she rams her face into the plastic a fin from the lens, jaw working, the aisle ripping
the seller woman drives into the lens picking her teeth with the fish bone and grinning, the bag swinging past with her still fighting

must_appear: she rides the moving tray to the last word, taken off only after 6.45; then card, belt, bag, buyer, her face in the plastic, the grin, one to a beat; belt and bag never stop; she is thrashing in the bag in the last frame; every line spoken, last word by 6.45
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a standing seller, a stopped belt, a still bag, a dead fish, a closed jaw while speaking, slow motion, an empty aisle, a word not in the lines, a foreign accent
